Corvane Labs is hiring an AI Engineer to build retrieval systems for legal research. You will join a small team in Austin, TX and work on-site five days a week.

In this role you will:
Build RAG pipelines over millions of court documents. Evaluate retrieval quality with offline benchmarks and ship improvements weekly. Work with lawyers to turn their feedback into labelled data.

Who you are:
You have 2-4 years of experience shipping machine learning systems to production. You are fluent in Python and have used PyTorch or Hugging Face transformers. You have worked with a vector database such as Pinecone, Qdrant or pgvector. A Master's degree in Computer Science, Statistics or a related field is preferred but not required.

Bonus points:
Experience fine-tuning LLMs with LoRA. Familiarity with LangGraph.

We sponsor H-1B visas for this role.
